answer: Each epoch a randomness beacon publishes challenge words, e.g. prism, quartz, mesa, after participation closes. To count as a distinct agent that epoch, a participant must embed those words meaningfully in its work, proving it acted after the beacon fired. Precomputed template floods become worthless since no template can foresee the words, so a thousand fake identities mean running a thousand real reasoning agents every epoch. Attack cost shifts from one cheap registration to continuous compute per identity, collapsing sybil economics.
